sections_target.text: Work Steps to be Carried Out

rows: Insert Test plug type RTXH 18 into Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay (X32G).
Short-circuit point x2A on Test plug type RTXH 18 and point x2A on Test plug type RTXP 18.
Inject voltage at points (9, 12) on the Test plug up to 20 V for phase R.
Inject current at points (3, 4) on the Test plug until the Alarm indication for phase R appears, with the phase shift set to Zero between voltage and current.
Switch off the current injection test set.
Connect the Start leads of the time measuring instrument to points (T1, T2) on the PHU-100 current injection test set.
Connect the Stop leads of the time measuring instrument to points (15, 18) on the RTXH 18 test plug.
Connect the current injection test set.
Change the angle between current and voltage to 60 degrees.
Raise the current until the alarm indication appears.
Switch off the current injection test set.
Connect the current injection test set.
Change the angle between current and voltage to 180 degrees.
Raise the current until we observe that the relay does not operate.
Inject voltage at points (10, 13) on the Test plug up to 20 V for phase S.
Inject current at points (5, 6) on the Test plug until the Alarm indication for phase S appears, with the phase shift set to Zero between voltage and current.
Connect the current injection test set.
Change the angle between current and voltage to 60 degrees.
Raise the current until the alarm indication appears.
Switch off the current injection test set.
Connect the current injection test set.
Change the angle between current and voltage to 160 degrees.
Raise the current until we observe that the relay does not operate.
Inject voltage at points (11, 14) on the Test plug up to 20 V for phase T.
Inject current at points (7, 8) on the Test plug until the Alarm indication for phase T appears, with the phase shift set to Zero between voltage and current.
Connect the current injection test set.
Change the angle between current and voltage to 60 degrees.
Raise the current until the alarm indication appears.
Switch off the current injection test set.
Connect the current injection test set.
Change the angle between current and voltage to 180 degrees.
Raise the current until we observe that the relay does not operate.
Switch off the current and voltage injection test sets.
Remove Test plug type RTXH 18 from Test socket type RTXP 18.

Introduction
This document sets out the test steps to be carried out annually. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at Assiut New Power Station ('El-Walidia', 2 x 300 MW), Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company, and the test was carried out on 18 October 2002 by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Eng. Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed.
Safety Precautions
The unit is out of service.
Open the work order.
Fence off the work area and place the necessary warning signs.
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.

PHU-100 voltage injection test set

Record the current reading. | 5

Connect the current injection test set. | 10
Record the time reading. | 11

Record the time reading. | 18

Inject voltage at points (11, 14) on the Test plug up to 20 V for phase T. | 36
Inject current at points (7, 8) on the Test plug until the Alarm indication for phase T appears, with the phase shift set to Zero between voltage and current. | 37
Record the current value. | 38
Reset the time measuring instrument. | 39
Connect the current injection test set. | 40
